en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Yeah, I already knew 
you were a pervert.

It's pointless to keep secrets 
from me. I've got my magic.

I don't feel like it... I'm low on 
mana, so my brain's all fuzzy...

I thought you were more considerate 
than that... Guess not...

Mana, the source of magic, 
accumulates when I'm relaxed.

So it's part of a mage's job to be 
bored sometimes.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
